response.sql:
WITH constructor_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.nationality,
    SUM(cr.points) AS total_points,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) AS constructor_count
  FROM constructors AS c
  JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.nationality
)
SELECT
  nationality,
  total_points,
  constructor_count,
  constructor_count - AVG(constructor_count) OVER () AS difference_from_average
FROM constructor_totals;

assumptions.assumption: The average is across nationalities represented by at least one constructor result; constructors with no constructor results are excluded.
